name: DSF Generalforsamlingen 2019
information:
Dette vil være en officiel WCA konkurrence. Efter konkurrencen vil der blive afholdt den årlige generalforsamling for [DSF](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DSFGeneralforsamlingen2019#8127-dsf-dansk-speedcubing-forening-danish-speedcubing-association). Mødet er forventet at starte klokken 17:00.

______
In addition to this being an official WCA Competition, the anual meeting of the [DSF](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DSFGeneralforsamlingen2019#8127-dsf-dansk-speedcubing-forening-danish-speedcubing-association) will be held after the official events of the competition. The expected start of the meeting is 17:00.
